dogecoin.text: on the other hand, these are the people who are paying spacex to launch their satellite in dogecoin. so it could really go either way.

DAY 4: elon musk tweets that SpaceX has a Starship stacked at Boca Chica “just ready to go whenever” as soon as NASA and the NNSA deliver them the nukes. $TSLA stock prices soar (spacex is not publicly traded). inexplicably, so does the price of dogecoin.
